title: The Wabansia outline check agrees on every Python
items: Nothing you can see changed. The check that re-derives Wabansia's tract outline from Wright's sheet was red on Python 3.13 and green on 3.11, over the same committed file.

The cause was a note copied into the data file: Python 3.13 trims a note's indentation and 3.11 keeps it. The note is now trimmed the same way on every version, and the check passes on 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13.
